subject: general
question: During which phase of the cell cycle does metabolic changes assemble the cytoplasmic material required for mitosis and cytokinesis?
solution:
The Correct Answer is** __G2 Phase__.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The G2 phase of the cell cycle **involves metabolic changes that assemble **cytoplasmic materials **necessary for** mitosis and cytokinesis**.
 
• This phase is followed by the **M phase**, where **nuclear division (mitosis) **is followed by **cell division (cytokinesis)**.
 
• Eukaryotic cells undergo a series of stages collectively known as the cell cycle, which includes** two gap phases (G1 and G2)**, an **S phase (synthesis)** where genetic material is duplicated, and an M phase where mitosis partitions the genetic material and the cell divides.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

__
 
• During **mitosis, chromosomes **replicated during the **S phase **are divided to ensure that each daughter cell receives a copy of **every chromosome**.
 
• This process results in the production of **two daughter cells **with the same genetic component as the parent cell.
 
• In actively dividing animal cells, the entire process typically takes about one hour.
 
• The final cellular division results in the formation of two new cells.
 
• Following mitosis is Meiosis II, where Meiosis I is a reduction division resulting in haploid cells with one copy of each chromosome.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **G1 phase:** During this phase, metabolic changes prepare the cell for division. At a specific point called the restriction point, the cell commits to division and enters the S phase.
 
• **S phase:** In this phase, DNA synthesis occurs, resulting in the replication of the genetic material. Each chromosome now consists of two sister chromatids.
 
• **G2 phase: **Metabolic changes in this phase assemble the cytoplasmic materials necessary for mitosis and cytokinesis.
 
• **M phase:** This phase involves nuclear division (mitosis) followed by cell division (cytokinesis).
